front.title: Operational Guidelines for BFD Monitoring in SRv6 Policies

abstract.t:
This document provides operational guidelines for Bidirectional Forwarding Detection (BFD) when applied to Segment Routing over IPv6 (SRv6) Policies. While the packet encapsulation mechanisms are standardized, this document focuses on the decisions network operators must make regarding mode selection, address management, traffic engineering integration, and troubleshooting strategies to ensure reliable service protection and efficient resource utilization.
It addresses practical challenges such as handling diverse tail-end node capabilities (IPv4/IPv6), managing BFD session overhead in large-scale segment lists, and diagnosing failure detection anomalies in source-routed paths.
